name: THR Hip Recovery & Full Body (7-Day Dual)
description: Dual-session program: morning gym strength & unilateral right-hip priority, plus evening home mobility & pelvic alignment.

morning.title: Lower body A + Push
morning.subtitle: Strength emphasis: controlled leg loading, glutes and chest

exercises.name: Leg press (shallow-to-moderate range)
exercises.notes: Keep in comfortable shallow range. Do NOT allow hip to bend past cleared angle or pinch at front.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.notes: Controlled eccentric return. Keep hips stable in the seat without tilting.

exercises.name: Supported low step-up
exercises.notes: Use a low step (4-6 in). Support hands on rails. Drive through right heel; watch for hip hiking.

exercises.name: Hip abductor machine (light & controlled)
exercises.notes: Pause 1 sec at peak abduction. Builds lateral glute stability.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.notes: Feet planted flat and stable without arching low back.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.notes: 30-45 degree bench. Smooth press, controlled descent.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.notes: Keep elbows tucked, brace core with neutral pelvis.

exercises.name: Pallof press (light cable resistance)
exercises.notes: Athletic stance, level pelvis. Resists trunk rotation, protects spine.

evening.title: Hip flexors, QL and Pelvic Control
evening.subtitle: Targeted rehabilitation and lighter accessory work

exercises.name: Gentle hip-flexor stretch
exercises.notes: Mild tension only. Stop immediately if any front pinch occurs.

exercises.name: Gentle standing QL stretch
exercises.notes: Lengthen side ribs. Do not crank or force lateral bend.

exercises.name: Supine pelvic tilts
exercises.notes: Flatten lower back into mat, feel lower abdominals engage.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes at top, maintain level hips, do not overextend lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction (bodyweight)
exercises.notes: No ankle weights initially. Slight backward angle, toe pointing slightly down.

exercises.name: Banded clamshells
exercises.notes: Light resistance band around knees. Pelvis stays perpendicular to floor.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: Opposite arm/leg reach within comfortable hip range.

exercises.name: Side plank from knees (if pain-free)
exercises.notes: Braces lateral sling (QL & glute medius) without excessive hip load.

morning.title: Upper Body Pull + Unilateral Legs
morning.subtitle: Strength emphasis: back, biceps and right-leg control

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Chest stays anchored, squeeze shoulder blades back smoothly.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown (comfortable grip)
exercises.notes: Medium or neutral grip. Pull smoothly toward collarbone.

exercises.name: Supported low step-up or sit-to-stand
exercises.notes: Right-side focus: controlled descent, level pelvis, no knee collapse.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.notes: Maintain knee alignment, slow 2-second negative.

exercises.name: Machine rear-delt fly
exercises.notes: Upper back and posture support. Avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
exercises.notes: Standing or seated tall with solid core bracing.

exercises.name: Cable anti-rotation hold
exercises.notes: Isometric core strength resisting rotational torque.

evening.title: Glute and Hip Stability
evening.subtitle: Evening home session with bands and core stability

exercises.name: Gentle hip-flexor and calf stretching
exercises.notes: Start slowly, let tissues warm up. Never force end ranges.

exercises.name: Banded clamshells
exercises.notes: Keep hips stacked vertically. Feel deep glute engagement.

exercises.name: Standing banded hip abduction
exercises.notes: Use a stable support. Keep pelvis level rather than hiking right hip.

exercises.name: Supported standing hip extension
exercises.notes: Band optional. Move from glute, do not arch lower back.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.notes: Even bilateral drive through both heels.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.notes: Keep hip square to ground as leg extends back.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold with light dumbbell
exercises.notes: Challenges lateral trunk and QL. Stand tall, zero tilting.

morning.title: Upper Body Strength + Light Legs
morning.subtitle: Emphasis: shoulders, arms and recovery from heavier leg work

exercises.name: Seated machine shoulder press (if comfortable)
exercises.notes: Avoid flared elbows. Neutral grip if available.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.notes: Upright posture, drive elbows back smoothly.

exercises.name: Machine chest fly (comfortable range)
exercises.notes: Moderate stretch across chest, do not over-extend shoulders.

exercises.name: Leg extension (light and controlled)
exercises.notes: Light quad stimulation, 2-sec hold at top, smooth lowering.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.notes: Light recovery volume for posterior chain.

exercises.name: Cable biceps curl
exercises.notes: Constant cable tension, controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Triceps rope extension
exercises.notes: Spread the rope at bottom contraction.

exercises.name: Dead bug (comfortable range)
exercises.notes: Maintain neutral lumbar curvature throughout.

evening.title: Mobility and Recovery
evening.subtitle: Gentle evening recovery, no figure-four or forced rotation

exercises.name: Gentle hip-flexor stretch
exercises.notes: Mild tension only. Keep torso upright.

exercises.name: Gentle QL stretch
exercises.notes: Gentle side reach, breathe into the ribs.

exercises.name: Heel slides in comfortable range
exercises.notes: Slide right heel on floor/towel. Stop well before any pinch!

exercises.name: Supported hip-abduction movement
exercises.notes: Gentle active range of motion, standing with support.

exercises.name: Pelvic tilts
exercises.notes: Supine on mat, relaxed breathing.

exercises.name: Easy walking or cycling
exercises.notes: Very light pace, flushes legs and promotes joint lubrication.

morning.title: Lower body B + Upper Accessories
morning.subtitle: Strength emphasis: posterior chain and controlled functional leg strength

exercises.name: Leg press (moderate range)
exercises.notes: Keep range strictly within comfortable, pinch-free limits. 3-4 RIR.

exercises.name: Glute bridge (cleared & pain-free)
exercises.notes: Can use light dumbbell across hips if cleared. Squeeze right glute intentionally.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.notes: Focus on full posterior chain control.

exercises.name: Supported step-up
exercises.notes: Hold rail for balance. Focus on pushing through heel and keeping pelvis level.

exercises.name: Hip abductor machine (light)
exercises.notes: Maintain steady tempo, avoid slamming weights.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.notes: Upper body accessory maintenance.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Solid upper back squeeze.

exercises.name: Farmer carry (light and even)
exercises.notes: Equal light dumbbells. Walk with tall posture and level pelvis; no waddling.

exercises.name: Hip-flexor and side-body stretching
exercises.notes: Smooth, relaxed stretches.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.notes: Hold 2 seconds at top contraction.

exercises.name: Banded clamshells
exercises.notes: Focus on right glute medius activation.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.notes: Controlled lift, pause at top, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing banded hip abduction
exercises.notes: Support with hands, keep trunk vertical.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.notes: Reach arm and opposite leg without rotating pelvis.

exercises.name: Side plank from knees (if cleared)
exercises.notes: Shoulders, hips, and knees in one straight line.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Firm brace on bench, strong rhomboid squeeze.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.notes: Controlled pressing motion.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: Wide or neutral grip.

exercises.name: Leg extension (light)
exercises.notes: Quadriceps strength without axial hip loading.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.notes: Balance quad work with hamstring isolation.

exercises.name: Supported standing hip abduction
exercises.notes: Slow eccentric control on right leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.notes: Light weight, focus on side deltoids.

exercises.name: Biceps curl + triceps pushdown
exercises.notes: Arm superset to conclude upper-body training.

evening.title: QL, Core and Pelvic Control
evening.subtitle: Targeting lateral trunk and hip synergy

exercises.name: Gentle hip-flexor stretch
exercises.notes: Keep front of right hip calm and un-pinched.

exercises.name: Gentle QL stretch
exercises.notes: Side lengthening without twisting.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: Anti-extension core control.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.notes: Maintain neutral spine and level hips.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold (light dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Should challenge lateral trunk/QL. Do not lean to one side.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.notes: Ensure right glute is firing as strongly as left.

exercises.name: Banded clamshells
exercises.notes: Light band, smooth reps.

morning.title: Light full-body technique + cardio
morning.subtitle: Technique focus, symmetrical loading, and controlled cardio

exercises.name: Treadmill walking
exercises.notes: Easy, flat walking; normal gait.

exercises.name: Elliptical cardio
exercises.notes: Low resistance, comfortable stride.

exercises.name: Sit-to-stand
exercises.notes: Stand up using both legs evenly. Control down.

exercises.name: Supported step-up
exercises.notes: Technique drill: zero hip hike, level pelvis.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Light weight, flawless mechanics.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.notes: Light weight, steady cadence.

exercises.name: Standing hip abduction
exercises.notes: Bodyweight or very light band.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.notes: Anti-rotation core brace.

exercises.name: Gentle stretching
exercises.notes: General gentle full-body and hip stretching.

exercises.name: Comfortable heel slides
exercises.notes: Keep knee tracking in line with hip.

exercises.name: Pelvic tilts
exercises.notes: Gentle coordination of anterior and posterior tilt.

exercises.name: Easy banded clamshells
exercises.notes: Lightest band, feeling glute turn on.

exercises.name: Optional easy walk
exercises.notes: Flat surface, comfortable walking stride.

morning.title: Recovery cardio only
morning.subtitle: Treadmill 10–15 min + Elliptical 5–10 min; easy joint recovery

exercises.name: Treadmill easy walk
exercises.notes: Easy, flat walking; normal gait. Focus on joint lubrication.

exercises.name: Elliptical easy glide
exercises.notes: Low resistance, comfortable stride without breathlessness.

evening.title: Gentle stretching
evening.subtitle: Gentle stretching only. No ankle weights or hard core drills.

exercises.name: Gentle hip-flexor and QL stretches
exercises.notes: Gentle relaxation before sleep. Never push through pinching.

exercises.name: Gentle calf and hamstring stretch
exercises.notes: Relaxed breathing. Do not force any range.
